name: hirelens
description: HireLens — AI video interview platform. Microservices backend (Node.js) + React frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,ai,interview,web -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w services/ai-service" "npm run dev -w services/interview-service" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,ai,interview -c blue,magenta,green "npm start -w services/gateway" "npm start -w services/ai-service" "npm start -w services/interview-service"
